Toyota brand name is visible, but no serial plate, country-of-origin label, or model tag is shown to confirm manufacturing origin.
No video or audio clip of the machine powered on; static photos cannot show motor performance.

claims.evidence: Witness report lists accessories, pedal, and manual as 'not shown'; no photo of these items alongside the machine.

claims.evidence: No service record, receipt, or internal mechanism photo provided; this is a seller assertion only.

risks.risk: Foot pedal, power cable, bobbins, and manual may be missing
risks.proof: Photo of all accessories, pedal, cable, and manual laid out next to the machine

risks.risk: Hidden rust, wear, or internal damage not visible from the two top-angle shots
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the underside, needle plate, belt, and internal bobbin area

risks.risk: Exact model/series unknown, which affects base value tier
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the nameplate or model/serial number sticker
risks.if_unproven: price at lowest-tier Toyota portable model value

risks.risk: Claimed Japanese origin unconfirmed; could be a later rebadged or regionally assembled unit

proof_requests: Video of the machine powered on and stitching fabric
Photo of all included accessories (pedal, cable, bobbins, manual) laid out together
Close-up photo of the nameplate/model/serial number
Photos of the underside and internal mechanism area for rust or wear
response.reason: The witness confirms a Toyota sewing machine, which is enough to assign a worst-case price; functionality, accessories, and origin claims remain unproven and should be priced conservatively until supporting shots are provided.
